incidents.name: Zoomer buyback contract spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The unverified ZOOMER buyback contract paid ETH for ZOOMER at the Uniswap V2 spot price, so a 200 ETH flash-loaned buy that pumped the WETH/ZOOMER pair let five freshly created contracts each sell 30.27M ZOOMER into it at the inflated rate.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x9700204D77A67A18eA8F1B47275897b21e5eFA97 created 2024-02-18T03:43:47Z by 0x3e49da81338d87c22f2f2c16d2874de2ad28c581, not the attack-tx sender 0xb0380b6d7a63e7cbf274c3b3c8838abbd6bd4abe; no EIP-1967 events. Balance diff across blocks 19291249->19291250 shows the victim's ETH falling from 17.300 to 0.152 ETH while its ZOOMER balance rose by 145.1M, confirming it bought ZOOMER for ETH at the manipulated spot price; ~17 ETH at a February 2024 ETH price near $2,950 clears the $1,000 floor. Repeated through five CREATE2 helper contracts, each capped at 30,265,400 ZOOMER. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 17.15 ETH x $2,927.14 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $50,200.
